name: Philadelphia
tagline: Affordable Northeast, World-Class Dining, and Deep American History
description: Philadelphia offers the cultural richness of a major Northeast city at a fraction of New York or Boston prices. The birthplace of American independence has transformed into a food destination with a thriving restaurant scene, excellent museums, and passionate sports culture. SEPTA provides solid public transit, and many neighborhoods are remarkably walkable. The combination of relatively affordable housing, no sales tax on clothing and groceries, and proximity to both New York and D.C. makes Philly a smart FIRE choice for those who want an urban East Coast lifestyle.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – safe in many neighborhoods; standard urban awareness needed
quickFacts.climate: Continental with warm, humid summers and cold winters

housing.description: Frugal 1BR on a cheaper block in South Philly or Fishtown

dining.description: Mostly home cooking; cheesesteaks and BYOB out occasionally

healthcare.description: A subsidized Silver plan through Pennie, Pennsylvania's ACA exchange, assuming annual income stays under the 2026 subsidy cutoff of about $62,600 for a single person; above that, the plan goes to full price. Priced for ages 45-55; older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: SEPTA monthly TransPass ($116) plus rare rideshare

entertainment.description: First Fridays, Schuylkill River Trail, Fairmount Park

1M.lifestyle: A frugal one-bedroom on a cheaper block in South Philly or Fishtown is comfortably within reach, and this is the main reason Philadelphia sits so much lower than New York or Boston — its housing floor is genuinely moderate. A SEPTA pass at $116 covers most trips, health is a MAGI-managed subsidized Silver plan through Pennie, and Pennsylvania's exemption of groceries and clothing from sales tax quietly lifts the budget. Cheesesteaks, Reading Terminal Market, and the city's BYOB culture make eating out affordable, while First Fridays, the Schuylkill River Trail, and Fairmount Park cost nothing. It is a real urban East Coast life on a lean budget.

housing.description: Nicer 1BR in Fishtown, Northern Liberties, or Graduate Hospital

dining.description: Out regularly across the city's strong scene

healthcare.description: Unsubsidized Silver/Gold for a ~50yo (above the cliff at a FIRE income)

2M.lifestyle: A nicer one-bedroom in Fishtown, Northern Liberties, or Graduate Hospital buys a lively, walkable neighborhood with the city's food scene at the doorstep. Dining out is a regular habit, healthcare is a solid unsubsidized Silver or Gold plan, and a SEPTA pass with Zipcar or rideshare covers the rest. Concerts, breweries, Phillies and Eagles games, and weekend trips to the Jersey Shore all fit. Philadelphia delivers a lot of urban life for the money at this level.

housing.description: Quality 1BR condo in Rittenhouse Square, Society Hill, or Chestnut Hill

dining.description: Frequent quality dining (Zahav, Vernick, the BYOB circuit)

healthcare.description: Unsubsidized Pennie Gold (SE-PA benchmark Silver ~$553 @45 / ~$712 @55), Penn Medicine network

transportation.description: Modest car with parking, or heavy rideshare plus Regional Rail

3M.lifestyle: A quality one-bedroom condo in Rittenhouse Square, Society Hill, or Chestnut Hill puts daily life in Philadelphia's most desirable, walkable core. Dining is frequent across a restaurant scene that has earned national attention — Zahav, Vernick, and the BYOB circuit — and healthcare is a proper unsubsidized Gold plan through the Penn Medicine network. A modest car or heavy rideshare plus Regional Rail covers errands and weekend drives to the Brandywine Valley or the shore. An orchestra subscription, Eagles games, and easy Amtrak access to New York and Washington round it out. The moderate cost base leaves real margin at this level.

housing.description: Luxury high-rise or amenity building near Rittenhouse Square

dining.description: Near-daily dining at the city's best tables

healthcare.description: Top unsubsidized plan plus concierge / direct-primary-care (Penn Medicine / Jefferson)

transportation.description: Luxury car with Center City parking, or first-class Acela

entertainment.description: Museum patronage, Eagles box seats, frequent trips

5M.lifestyle: A luxury high-rise or amenity building near Rittenhouse Square, with a weekly housekeeper, marks an upper-affluent Philadelphia life. Fine dining is a near-daily option at the city's best tables, healthcare adds a concierge or direct-primary-care retainer to a top plan, and a nice car with Center City parking or first-class Acela handles travel. Museum patronage, Eagles box seats, and frequent trips are comfortable within the budget. The city's relative affordability means this level of spending buys a genuinely well-appointed life with room to spare.

housing.description: Historic Rittenhouse mansion or a grand Main Line estate

dining.description: A private chef plus the region's finest tables

healthcare.description: Top plan plus premium concierge (Penn Medicine / Jefferson executive health)

transportation.description: One premium vehicle plus car service / first-class Acela

entertainment.description: Premium club seats and season tickets, museum-trustee involvement, international travel

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeping twice a week plus occasional extra help

10M.lifestyle: A historic Rittenhouse mansion or a grand Main Line home, kept by housekeeping twice a week with extra help when needed, anchors life at the top of Philadelphia — and because the city's cost base is moderate, the budget stretches further here than it would in New York. Dining spans a private chef and the region's finest tables, healthcare is a top plan with Penn Medicine or Jefferson executive-concierge access, and one premium vehicle plus car service — or first-class Acela — covers travel up and down the corridor. Premium club seats and season tickets, museum-trustee involvement, bespoke travel, and a philanthropy budget are all comfortable. This is established wealth in a city that quietly delivers more lifestyle per dollar than its neighbors, with Manhattan an hour away when wanted.
